coming-soon-flips-a.summary: A coming soon teaser on tangerine and navy plates. Condensed cream or navy words hard cut one at a time, HOLD YOUR BREATH WHAT'S NEXT IS LANDING, each with a short bar growing under it, and the second BREATH stutters through serif, marker, brush and thin typefaces. coming-soon-flips-b.concept: A suspense teaser that says one condensed word per hard cut between two bold plates, stutters through typefaces on the breath beat, then lands on an outlined plus solid ALMOST HERE while slatted window light rakes a plaster wall to find the logo and name. Short, punchy, teasing copy; the eye goes word, title, then logo.

Company Name.hint: Brand or product name under the logo on the lit wall at the very end; one line, long names shrink. Leave empty if your logo already spells the name

Logo.hint: Brand logo painted on the wall and found by the light; wide, square or round, shown whole

coming-soon-flips-c.summary: A coming soon teaser in plum and coral. Tall condensed cream or plum words hard cut one at a time, HOLD YOUR BREATH WHAT'S NEXT IS LANDING, each with a short bar growing under it, and the second BREATH stutters through serif, marker, brush and thin typefaces. After a two frame flash of a lilac plaster wall, flat horizontal blinds of light roll down the wall across the logo and name, leave the wall, roll back up, then open into one band that rests on the logo and name, while an outlined ALMOST over a solid coral HERE flickers on and tracks in beneath them as one lockup.
